scope: Private non-feedback GPU J-observer allocation/identity lifecycle component. Actual LoadConfig/ConfigDomain/InitRunGpu, real periodic duplication, real cell sorting, resize and production host/CUDA J updates. No force call, physical time step or public GPU dynamic model.
source_freeze: Use the root-frozen five-file upl_gpu_observer Debug/Release authoritative build; link all active actual GPU project objects except main. No production-source edits by this fixture.
cli: --state followed by normal -gpu/-stable sealed_case_prefix fresh_output arguments; the --state marker is removed before JSphCfgRun::LoadArgv.
input: Existing genuine 512-soil, zero-wall, 2-D axis-XZ periodic default-OFF seed; shared HydroMechDynamicSeepage remains false. No GenCase, field interpolation or formal case changes. Root/P0 binds exact seed/program/source/runtime in the optional second-fixture recipe.

component_changes.initial_J: Production initialization must be exactly1 for every native and current periodic slot; theta exactly+0.
component_changes.manufactured_tags: J=1+(id+1)/65536, theta=(id%9-4)/32; all binary-representable. No mechanical equilibrium or physical deformation meaning is claimed.
component_changes.dt: Observer-only full dt=2^-10; predictor host method receives2^-11, corrector2^-10. It is not a physical fixed-step admission.
component_changes.position_test: Exchange only positions and Dcell values of actual normal IDs0 and511 in distinct cells, then real RunCellDivide(true). IDs/J/theta are not manually permuted.
component_changes.predictor_lifecycle: Only actual ComputeSymplecticPorosity is called, so JPre is live while all physical Pos/Vel PRE pointers are NULL. Subsequent actual RunPeriodic must still copy JPre outside varspre.
component_changes.resize: Actual ResizeParticlesSize(old_GPU_capacity+1,0,false) with JPre live; require larger capacity and exact active-slot identity, then normal RunCellDivide(true) regeneration.
component_changes.plastic_negative_controls: Set every current periodic Kplastic to123 with all normal-native Kplastic0: corrector must succeed. Separately set one normal native Kplastic1: actual corrector must throw. Recover only private diagnostic J arrays between independent component guard cases; never retry a solver.
component_changes.invalid_J: Predictor rejects J exactly at solid0=1-double(n0), NaN and +Inf in three independent native-slot guard cases.

gates.identity: Every current ID is0..511 and fluid; exactly512 unique normal IDs; all other active slots must be periodic; original NpfOut0. Copy/sort/periodic/resize J/theta/live-JPre bit-exact by native ID against the actual pre-sort reference.
gates.actual_reorder: Native-ID order must change after exchanging two distinct native cells. An unchanged order fails.
gates.clone_of_clone: Nonempty same-ID periodic images offset in BOTH X and Z by the actual PeriXinc.x/PeriZinc.z. Together with frozen RunPeriodic cblock/axis ordering this witnesses clone-of-clone coverage; no fake inserted kernel counter.
gates.recurrence: Independently compute predictor Tag+dt/2*Tag*Rate and corrector saved-Jn+dt*actual-Jhalf*new-theta. Error <=16*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,abs(actual),abs(reference)); no CPU/GPU0-ULP arithmetic claim. Corrector releases JPre.
gates.ledger: Finite0<n<1 and abs((1-n)*J-(1-n0))<=5e-13; conditional incompressible-solid invariant, not exact fluid mass.
gates.tail: Seven bounded persistent J/theta tail slots are unchanged across isolated corrector only; no tail promise across periodic regeneration/resize.
gates.guards: Three bad-J cases and native plastic guard must throw the exact existing finite-saturated-elastic exception; periodic-only plastic poison must not throw.
gates.no_physics: TimeStep and Nstep remain0, actual force calls0; no ComputeStep/Run trajectory, half-step, physical or public GPU acceptance.
gates.memcheck: Root may run Debug under compute-sanitizer with original zero-error/zero-leak gates, then Release only on complete Debug pass. This author does not execute.

actual_prefix_limit: With PeriActive, JCellDivGpuSingle::Divide invalidates BoundDivideOk and performs full division; Npb=0 also makes any prefix0. Therefore actual_nonzero_prefix_cell_division=false. The earlier576-case actual copy/sort component covers nonzero API prefixes; no forced count flag or wall admission is fabricated here.
